_comment: Generic pipeline settings — no URLs, safe to commit to this public repo. The real reference-blog list lives in sources.local.json (gitignored). See sources.example.json for its shape, and docs/blog.md for what all of this does.

conventions._ramp_note: Dormant by design: no floor until 3 posts exist, because an unsatisfiable gate just gets disabled and never comes back. There is deliberately no word or H2 band — `blog check` prints the real corpus distribution instead of pretending a 0-20000 placeholder is a rule.

scoring._note: Four axes, all higher-is-better, none inverted. scores.total is NOT stored on an idea — scripts/lib/backlog.mjs computes it from these weights on read, so it cannot drift from the axes it is derived from.

_cadence_note: How long a stored ETag/Last-Modified may be trusted before scan forces an unconditional refetch. A server that answers 304 forever must not be able to hide a change indefinitely.
